scripts.copy: rm -rf ./public/download ./public/diagrams && cp -r ../cli/templates/output ./public/download && cp ../runner/templates/output/* ./public/download/ && cp ../api/openapi.json ./public/download/openapi.json && cp -r diagrams/output ./public/diagrams
scripts.diagrams: mkdir -p diagrams/output && mmdc -i diagrams/architecture.mmd -o diagrams/output/architecture.svg && mmdc -i diagrams/schema.mmd -o diagrams/output/schema.svg && mmdc -i diagrams/bare-metal.mmd -o diagrams/output/bare-metal.svg && mmdc -i diagrams/runner-setup.mmd -o diagrams/output/runner-setup.svg && mmdc -i diagrams/runner-protocol.mmd -o diagrams/output/runner-protocol.svg && mmdc -i diagrams/job-status.mmd -o diagrams/output/job-status.svg
scripts.setup: npm run typeshare && npm run wasm && npm run copy
scripts.dev: npm run setup && export BENCHER_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:6610 && export OAUTH_GITHUB=true && export OAUTH_GOOGLE=true && astro dev --port 3000
scripts.dev:dev-api: npm run setup && export BENCHER_API_URL=https://dev.api.bencher.dev && export OAUTH_GITHUB=true && export OAUTH_GOOGLE=true && astro dev --port 3000
scripts.build: export $(cat .env.runtime) && npm run copy && astro build
scripts.node: npm ci && npm run adapter node && npm run build
scripts.cloudflare: npm ci && npm run adapter cloudflare && npm run build && npm run pagefind:cloudflare
scripts.preview: export BENCHER_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:6610 && export OAUTH_GITHUB=true && OAUTH_GOOGLE=true && astro preview --port 3000
